title: Salesforce Data 360 file sharing will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
The Salesforce Data 360 file sharing connector (formerly Salesforce Data Cloud file sharing) will be available by default for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled.

Use the connector in Lakehouse Federation to query Salesforce Data 360 data directly from cloud object storage without copying it into Databricks. Queries run on Databricks compute.

See [Lakehouse Federation for Salesforce Data 360 File Sharing](/aws/en/query-federation/salesforce-data-cloud-file-sharing).
